name: ecommerce-platform
description: Multipurpose ecommerce platform — deploy multiple storefronts from one codebase.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @platform/shared && npm run build -w @platform/site-config && npm run build -w @platform/react-busy && npm run build -w @platform/api-client
scripts.openapi:generate: npm run build -w @platform/shared && npm run openapi:generate -w @platform/server
scripts.format: npm run api:format && npm run format -w @platform/admin && npm run format -w @platform/storefront && npm run format -w @platform/server
scripts.format:check: npm run api:format:check && npm run format:check -w @platform/admin && npm run format:check -w @platform/storefront && npm run format:check -w @platform/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @platform/shared && npm run typecheck -w @platform/site-config && npm run typecheck -w @platform/react-busy && npm run typecheck -w @platform/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @platform/server && tsc --noEmit -p admin && tsc --noEmit -p client && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @platform/server
